finding.comment: records_file is JSONL, one object per line, but all(.[]; .success) expects a single array document; the gate inspects each object's own fields and the input format is misread.

files.patch:
--- a/ci/report_gate.sh
+++ b/ci/report_gate.sh
@@ -2,3 +2,5 @@
 # build results arrive as JSONL (one object per line):
 #   jq -c '.builds[]' <<<"$payload" >>"$records_file"
+jq 'all(.[]; .success)' <"$records_file" >/dev/null
+echo "all builds succeeded"

rationale: unslurped all() consumer over documented JSONL
